query: SELECT json_build_object('owned_rows',count(*),'live_rows',count(*) FILTER (WHERE expires_at>clock_timestamp()),'members',(SELECT count(*) FROM scheduler_members),'run_status',(SELECT status FROM runs LIMIT 1),'leased_reserve',(SELECT count(*) FROM steps WHERE node='reserve' AND status='LEASED')) FROM scheduler_shards WHERE owner IS NOT NULL
diagnosis: Fixture oracle counted retained expired shard-owner rows as active ownership. Native release expires rows; withdraw removes membership. No production defect or refusal execution was observed.
